# AcademyStudio

Studio delivers Courses, Tafseer and Mothers of the Ummah with the Circles interface. Academy owns master identity and published timetables; Studio owns its transferred content and material access.

## Working folders

- public/: the complete current website source and approved public artwork.
- src/: the Studio backend and permission checks.
- migrations/: the ordered database history; retain every migration.
- tests/: synthetic regression and permission tests.
- tools/: build, release and checked media-administration tools.
- config/: separate preview and historical connection environments.
- routing/: the existing Academy-account domain router.
- docs/: current guidance; historical release notes are under docs/history/releases/.
- release/: the current reviewed manifest and source metadata, without copied website builds.

wrangler.production.jsonc is the single current production configuration. wrangler.jsonc is deliberately disabled and local-only. The existing hosting remains unchanged; the Pages migration is a separate, unbuilt plan.

## Build and release

GitHub is the source of truth. Build and test on GitHub runners; no Mac writes or deletion are authorised. The website is built directly from public/, without using a previous release folder. Generated release/v*/ folders are ignored build output.

The current reviewed manifest is release/manifest.json. Rebuilding its version must reproduce every public filename and byte, including the existing immutable asset addresses. A changed website needs a new reviewed version. Future releases update the same manifest and production configuration instead of adding versioned configuration files and full website copies.

Use Actions → Build release package in GitHub for comparison or a new package. The paired Academy and Studio workflow runs synthetic checks. Deployment requires separate explicit approval; a source push does not deploy.

Keep 43200/43200/60 verification, all permissions, existing media and manual attachment/publication. Hifz is outside this repository cleanup.

## Recovery

rollback/studio-before-housekeeping-20261104 preserves the complete repository before this cleanup. Git history and reviewed GitHub release records retain older versions. Do not rewrite history or use the Mac for backup storage.

# AcademyStudio working rules

GitHub is the source of truth: MaktabForlife/AcademyStudio, primary branch studio_dev.

## Current authorised scope

The owner authorised repository housekeeping and asked that it be applied directly to studio_dev, with rollback/studio-before-housekeeping-20261104 preserved. This authorises source organisation, GitHub-run build/tests and reviewed GitHub commits only. No deployment, DNS, hosted SQL/data/rights/media changes or Hifz changes are authorised.

The proposed hosting migration remains a plan: Academy will own the homepage/shared dashboard at maktab4life.org; Studio Pages and its existing backend/storage will be in the Studio account at studio.maktab4life.org; Studio keeps its secure cookie and Hifz remains unchanged. Do not build or deploy that migration under the housekeeping approval.

## Local files and privacy

Never delete any file, local branch or worktree from the owner's Mac. New local writes require explicit permission. Run builds/tests in GitHub, not on the Mac. Recovery belongs in GitHub and Cloudflare, not local backup/media folders.

Repositories are public. Never commit credentials, session tokens, private R2 teaching content, account exports or private review material. Approved public website assets and infrastructure identifiers are not credentials. Keep credential scans and exact reviewed manifests in release checks.

## Application and release rules

Preserve master identity/session/credential-version checks, scoped Admin authority, acquired Course/month/cohort/Surah/playlist rights, account-switch guards and the exact five-minute Join opening rule.

Ordinary verification is 43200 seconds, live-access verification is 43200 seconds, and sensitive Admin freshness is 60 seconds. Cookie lifetime is separate. Do not weaken permissions to reduce reads.

All real media attachment and publication remain manual. Use synthetic test data; avoid production app loads, table scans and hosted SQL. Keep any separately approved live checks small.

Academy and Studio are one tested release. No merge, force-push, history replacement, independent automatic deployment or deployment without current approval. Start synchronisation commit messages with [CF-Pages-Skip] [skip ci].

## Source and packaging

public/ contains the complete current public website. src/ contains the backend. Keep migrations and meaningful tests.

Build directly from source. Generated release/v*/ website packages are ignored; retain only current manifest/source metadata in release/. wrangler.production.jsonc is the current production config; wrangler.jsonc is local-only and disabled. Historical configurations and authorisations remain available through the rollback branch and Git history, not as current operating instructions.

The deployed release's cache address may be retained only while every generated public filename and byte matches release/manifest.json. New website changes require a new reviewed version. Preserve licences and verify generated packages before any future release.
config/README.md: These are separate preview/connection environments, retained for existing test and administration tools. The active production configuration is ../wrangler.production.jsonc. Their bindings and runtime policies are preserved; none is deployment approval. Use only GitHub runners unless local writes are explicitly approved.

# Studio repository structure

The November 2026 housekeeping establishes a complete public source tree and a source-only package build. The live release, backend, database migrations, permissions, media, origins and DNS do not change.

Previously, release preparation copied an older frozen package and overlaid changes. Four full packages and twenty version-specific root configurations accumulated. Sixty-two files used by the current package existed only in release copies. Those files are now represented in public/; their published asset addresses are regenerated during packaging.

The recovery branch rollback/studio-before-housekeeping-20261104 retains the exact previous tree. Historical release notes are under docs/history/releases/; historical source/configuration bytes remain in Git history. No history is rewritten and no Mac files are touched.

Current release metadata:
- release/current.json selects the reviewed version.
- release/manifest.json records every reviewed public filename and hash.
- release/source.json records source version-stamping metadata.
- wrangler.production.jsonc is the single current deployment configuration.

GitHub builds recreate release/v<version>/public as ignored output. Comparison builds verify every public byte against the reviewed manifest. New release packaging records a new manifest and updates the same production config; it does not commit another website copy.

The hosted Studio backend, routing and all migrations must retain their exact pre-cleanup source bytes. The proof includes public-asset equivalence, synthetic Academy/Studio permission/media tests, static-route checks, bundle compilation and configuration parity. Housekeeping is not deployment approval.
